name: Daily Sample Requests
query: SELECT dsr.requested_time AS "Requested On:Datetime:140", CASE WHEN dsr.reference_image IS NOT NULL AND dsr.reference_image != '' THEN CONCAT('') ELSE '' END AS "Reference Image:HTML:150", dsr.name AS "Sample ID:Link/Daily Sample Request:140", dsr.buyer AS "Buyer:Link/Customer:120", dsr.style AS "Style Code:Data:120", dsr.sample_type AS "Sample Type:Data:120", dsr.gauge AS "Gauge:Data:80", /* 🔥 YARN */ ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CONCAT(yarn_composition, ' ', yarn_count) SEPARATOR ' + ' ) FROM `tabMaterial Requirement` WHERE parent = dsr.name ) AS "Yarn Details:Data:250", dsr.merchandiser_display AS "Merchandiser:Data:120", srq.size AS "Size:Data:80", srq.color AS "Color:Data:80", srq.quantity AS "Qty:Int:80", dsr.remarks AS "Remarks:Data:200" FROM `tabDaily Sample Request` dsr LEFT JOIN `tabSample Request Quantity` srq ON srq.parent = dsr.name WHERE dsr.docstatus < 2 AND ( IFNULL(%(start_date)s, '') = '' OR DATE(dsr.requested_time) >= %(start_date)s ) AND ( IFNULL(%(end_date)s, '') = '' OR DATE(dsr.requested_time) <= %(end_date)s ) ORDER BY dsr.requested_time DESC, dsr.name;
